_comment: Known-acceptable wrap-fuzz divergence signatures per browser. The generative fuzzer (tests/wrap-fuzz.test.ts) FAILS when a structural line-count divergence appears whose signature is NOT listed here, or when ANY box-overflow is found. The two chrome residuals are extreme-narrow (width 90/130) break-word cases with a 0.6em font run mid-word: off-by-one line count from cumulative cross-font measurement drift (an inherent canvas-API limitation, see CLAUDE.md 'Text measurement'); nothing overflows. To update deliberately after a verified change: run the fuzzer, copy the linecount signatures from tests/wrap-report.fuzz-<browser>.json into the matching browser array below.
